input.raw_text: Offers collateral-free and guarantor-free education loans for meritorious students admitted to designated Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs), featuring a 3% interest subvention for families with an annual income up to ₹8,00,000. Applications are handled online via the PM-Vidyalaxmi Portal.

claim: Government of India provides collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans with 3% interest subvention for income up to ₹8 Lakh under the PM-Vidyalaxmi Scheme via official portal.

confidence.rationale: Corroborated by official Press Information Bureau (PIB) Cabinet approvals, Department of Higher Education notifications, and the official PM-Vidyalaxmi digital portal.

plain_explanation: This forward accurately describes the PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme approved by the Union Cabinet. Under this central sector initiative, meritorious students admitted into designated Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) can secure collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans, with a 3% interest subvention provided for families with an annual income up to ₹8,00,000.

evidence.source_name: Press Information Bureau (PIB), Government of India
evidence.excerpt: Cabinet approves PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme to provide financial support to meritorious students for higher education. For students having an annual family income of up to ₹8 lakhs, 3 percent interest subvention will be provided on education loans up to ₹10 lakhs.

evidence.source_name: Ministry of Education - Department of Higher Education
evidence.excerpt: Under the PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme, students admitted to designated top 860 Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) are eligible for collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans through a transparent digital portal.

counter_arguments_checked: Is the scheme restricted to specific educational institutions?
Are all students eligible for the 3% interest subvention regardless of income?
edge_cases_identified: The loan is available to students in top NIRF-ranked QHEIs. The 3% interest subvention specifically applies to families with annual gross income up to ₹8 Lakhs and is capped at ₹10 Lakhs loan amount during the moratorium period.
stress_test.robustness_summary: The claim is fully supported by authoritative government gazette records. Eligible students must apply exclusively through the official digital portal.

truth_timeline.event: Union Cabinet approved the PM-Vidyalaxmi central sector initiative for higher education financial assistance.
truth_timeline.significance: Formal policy enactment with budgetary allocation of ₹3,600 crore.

truth_timeline.event: Ministry of Education launched the unified digital application portal and published list of 860 QHEIs.
truth_timeline.significance: Operationalized direct digital applications without bank branch intermediaries.

truth_timeline.event: Current guidelines confirm ongoing active status for higher education loan disbursement.
truth_timeline.significance: Scheme remains fully active and authoritative.

action_risk.recommended_action: Authentic government scheme. To apply, use exclusively the official portal at pmvidyalaxmi.gov.in. Beware of unverified third-party websites or agents asking for processing fees.
